soft_regions.reason: Use a coarse tetrahedral covering volume enclosing the native saddle vertices with pinned underside attached to seat_carrier. Bind every skin vertex by nonnegative normalized tetrahedral weights with rest reconstruction tolerance; do not clamp outside points. Apply a real downward contact probe centrally while seat is closed, then unload and measure local displacement and recovery relative to owner. Preserve actual failed attempt if unstable; no rigid squash substitute.

interactions.name: rigid_motion_test
interactions.action: In one host action plan exercise hinges individually and meaningful combinations. Check visible connection and ownership at finite minimum/middle/maximum; wheels at quarter-turn poses through at least one complete unwrapped turn. Check steering carries front spin and levers. Spin velocity target 2 rad/s for enough time to exceed 2*pi, bounded torque 5 N*m, then stop; no angle ctrlrange/range. Never finite-limit wheel joints.
interactions.expected: Retain useful full planned motion and native surfaces; numerical and visible receipts distinguish actual success from preview-only control. Seat opens with soft owner pins following its carrier.

interactions.name: saddle_press_test
interactions.action: With seat closed, settle, press by real contact 0.025 m, hold, retract and recover; record flex trajectories and visible nonrigid displacement after removing owner rigid transform. Test seat-opening owner-follow in the same short attempt.
interactions.expected: Localized visible compression and recovery, not rigid translation; report measured displacement, rest binding error, recovery and any failure honestly.

review_requirements: Before motion, inspect colored ownership and textured rest views: assign every source face exactly once; retain UV/PBR; saddle exclusively belongs to saddle_cushion and seat_carrier has no native surface. Check tire/rim/disc versus fork/caliper/drive-cover separation, both complete lever blades, mirror stalks, stand and saddle seam. Broad envelopes alone are insufficient masks. Record local wheel/boss fitting and consistent native-to-SI, child-local and preview-offset transforms; preserve the step-through opening.

Use bounded visual/kinematic checks at minimum, midpoint and maximum of steer, left_press, right_press, stand_fold and seat_open. Verify levers turn toward grips around their bosses, stand folds toward its attachment, saddle lifts with its pinned underside, and steering carries handlebars/mirrors/fork/fender/front wheel while shield stays fixed. Check visible attachment continuity, not just joint coordinates. For wheel spins inspect quarter-turn representative poses through a full turn, retaining axle attachment and stationary caliper/cover ownership. Document exposed gaps; any connector uses only the approved repair, correct owner and area budget. These checks require no additional dynamics run.

Compiled MJCF must contain both spin hinges with limited=false and no range or finite angle actuator bounds; demonstrate each wheel through at least 2*pi unwrapped rotation in the one host attempt. Attempt all five limited hinges over their declared ranges, including coupled steering/front-wheel and seat-owner motion. Record attained qpos, finite-state and visible mesh displacement evidence, distinguishing measured success from preview controls or failed motion; never convert wheel spin to oscillation.

Build actual coarse saddle flex with underside pins following seat_carrier. Verify all visible skin vertices have nonnegative normalized weights and rest reconstruction error <=0.001 metric object diagonal. In the single host attempt, contact-load and unload the closed saddle and report contact, owner-relative nonrigid surface displacement and recovery; also check binding during seat opening. Compare displacement against the declared 0.01 relative-surface threshold and report failures honestly. Rigid owner movement, deferred coverings or render-only squash cannot count as saddle deformation.

Use simple documented proxies and explicit allowed adjacent-pair exclusions; preserve nonadjacent contact. Report sampled neutral/motion penetration using the frozen 1% diagonal baseline; use the 3% object/10% part/10% area extension only with complete measured locality evidence. No extra simulation or fine contact sweep is required. Preserve full continuous joints and useful interactions on failure; any optional limited-joint backoff requires existing helper receipts and consistent artifacts. Deliver GLB/MJCF/action-plan/manifest with each action marked simulated success, failed, parameter-preview-only or missing, and no strict collision-free or full acceptance claim.

interaction_coverage.label: Independent wheel rotation
interaction_coverage.reason: Two visible tire/rim rings and axles support unrestricted rotation; initial oblique pose is not the axle direction.

interaction_coverage.label: Coupled steering
interaction_coverage.reason: Handlebars, mirrors, fork/fender and front wheel turn together; fixed shield stays on chassis.

interaction_coverage.label: Press both visible hand levers
interaction_coverage.reason: Short rotation toward the grips inferred from blade/boss geometry. 0.35 rad is an editable constrained pressing prior, not measured travel.

interaction_coverage.label: Fold deployed support
interaction_coverage.reason: Visible deployed support attaches beneath frame; infer transverse pivot and fold rearward through 90 degrees.

interaction_coverage.label: Lift saddle assembly
interaction_coverage.reason: Distinct saddle underside seam supports a bounded front-hinge hypothesis; hidden latch and opening are not observed.

interaction_coverage.label: Press and release padded saddle
interaction_coverage.reason: Visible padded profile warrants one real local deformation and recovery attempt.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional material compliance
interaction_coverage.reason: These coverings retain native geometry under their actual owner; no active soft claim.

interaction_coverage.label: Possible suspension response
interaction_coverage.reason: Fork/support geometry is compatible with suspension but internal linkage and travel are not established; not part of completed core coverage.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Record visible fork and rear spring as retained chassis/steering geometry. A future bounded local stroke attempt needs a reviewed split of telescoping/support surfaces; do not claim suspension success in this candidate.

interaction_coverage.label: Possible grip twist and mirror adjustment
interaction_coverage.reason: Control internals and mirror adjustment sockets are not resolved; independent adjustment is not demonstrated.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Keep native grips and mirrors attached to steering; preserve this gap for a later evidence-supported local pivot/axial split rather than invent a present functional claim.

deferred_compliance.name: backrest_padding
deferred_compliance.reason: Padded appearance; secondary deformation omitted after active saddle attempt.

deferred_compliance.name: front_tire_rubber
deferred_compliance.reason: Tire compliance omitted while full wheel rotation is retained.

deferred_compliance.name: rear_tire_rubber
deferred_compliance.reason: Unknown tire construction; retained rotating native covering.

deferred_compliance.name: grip_covering
deferred_compliance.reason: Potential elastomer on grips follows handlebar; texture alone does not establish load response.

deferred_compliance.name: floor_insert
deferred_compliance.reason: Potential yielding floor insert follows chassis; no tested compression claim.

approximation_gaps.reason: Only saddle deformation is attempted; backrest, tires, grip and floor coverings follow rigid owners unchanged.
Native hidden/underside gaps and texture artifacts remain. No storage cavity or concealed mechanism reconstruction; only approved small connectors.

Use wheel cylinders, fork/bar capsules and multiple shell/chassis boxes preserving the step-through opening. Approximate proxies omit fine tread, cables and concavity; adjacent joint contacts may use declared exclusions. Keep nonadjacent contact enabled and record the 1% diagonal tolerance, using larger locality allowance only with actual evidence.
